# CodeGraph Full Machine-Readable Brief

## Canonical definition

CodeGraph — платформа сквозной прослеживаемости и доказательного исполнения требований в Product Development Lifecycle. Product Intent становится проверяемыми FR/NFR и acceptance criteria; требования связываются с Impact Scope, Task Capsules, Code Changes, behavioral tests, Check Results and Evidence. Conformance status показывает, что реализовано, что подтверждено и где остаются gaps, exceptions or blockers.

The category is requirements traceability and evidence-based execution in PDLC. “Digital team” describes the governed execution model. Code Property Graph is a technical mechanism for code impact and data-flow analysis. Neither term replaces the product category.

## Canonical object chain

1. Product Intent — approved product purpose, boundary and decision owner.
2. Source / Provenance — origin, version, author and approval context.
3. FR / NFR — functional and non-functional obligations.
4. Acceptance Criterion — observable pass/fail behavior.
5. Impact Scope — affected components, symbols, data paths and test areas.
6. Task Capsule — bounded work, owner, allowed actions, stop conditions and evidence contract.
7. Code Change — implementation linked to an approved requirement.
8. Behavioral Test — executable evidence that checks the required behavior.
9. Check Result — dated output of a named validation method.
10. Role Evidence — first-person lane outcome with evidence references.
11. Gap / Exception / Residual Risk — explicit unresolved condition or accepted deviation.
12. Requirement Implementation Status — implemented, partial, unconfirmed or blocked, based on evidence rather than narrative Done.

## Authority boundaries

- CodeGraph can prepare and verify technical evidence within an approved scope.
- Product scope, requirement approval and product outcome remain human decisions.
- Residual-risk acceptance and release/go-no-go remain with accountable people.
- Automated checks, headless QA or a generated narrative do not independently prove full delivery closure.
- A capability found in source code does not prove configuration, credentials, live connection, production readiness or commercial availability.

## Page map

- https://codegraph.ru/ — category, six-stage flow, CPO/CTO views, proof chain and pilot decision.
- https://codegraph.ru/whitepaper.html — canonical object model, status semantics, authority and trust boundaries.
- https://codegraph.ru/product-delivery.html — Product Intent to requirements, Impact Scope, Task Capsule and conformance status.
- https://codegraph.ru/evidence.html — bounded anonymised traceability example, gaps and unverified items.
- https://codegraph.ru/digital-team.html — thirteen governed role contracts with allowed actions, prohibited decisions, evidence and stop conditions.
- https://codegraph.ru/integrations.html — dated capability-depth matrix for auth, import, events, writeback, CI/action and export.
- https://codegraph.ru/ai-engineering.html — requirement-bound AI work, separation of execution and review, and limitations.
- https://codegraph.ru/cpg.html — Code Property Graph as an impact-analysis mechanism.
- https://codegraph.ru/security.html — security requirement to evidence and residual-risk decision.
- https://codegraph.ru/compliance.html — data boundary, decision log and evidence of technical controls.
- https://codegraph.ru/platform-operations.html — deployment, integration, runtime state, health and recovery boundaries.
- https://codegraph.ru/productivity.html — CTO view of engineering conformance and unresolved gaps.
- https://codegraph.ru/business-efficiency.html — baseline, flow/traceability measures, guardrails and scale/fix/stop decision.
- https://codegraph.ru/docs/ru/index.html — Russian operator and product documentation.
- https://codegraph.ru/docs/en/index.html — English documentation projection.

## Proof interpretation

Evidence should name the requirement, source, version, method, timestamp and result. A public example is illustrative unless it identifies a reproducible dataset and method. A pilot target is a hypothesis agreed for that pilot, not a universal benchmark or customer outcome. Provider, deployment and integration claims must be read with their dated limitations.

## Next step

The public CTA is a review of one product initiative. Its bounded output is a draft Product Intent → FR/NFR → Impact Scope → required evidence chain. It is not a promise to generate a complete specification automatically.
